# `onExitFailureToOnError`

Suggests Effect.onError when an Effect.onExit callback only acts on failure

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377184` |
| Language Service name | `onExitFailureToOnError` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/on-exit-failure-to-on-error` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect, Exit } from "effect"

declare const program: Effect.Effect<number, string>

program.pipe(
  Effect.onExit((exit) =>
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(on-exit-failure-to-on-error): Effect.onError expresses this failure-only Effect.onExit callback more directly.
*/
    Exit.isFailure(exit)
      ? Effect.logError("failed", { cause: exit.cause })
      : Effect.void
  )
)
```
